name: goldilocks
description: A Direct-first adaptive workflow and quality-control layer for any executable work.

interface.longDescription: Provides a thin, domain-agnostic Goldilocks router plus optional alignment, planning, debugging, continuity, delegation, and verification. Any executable work may enter; clear work exits to Direct, while durable, risky, or genuinely decomposable work loads only the capability whose trigger is present.
defaultPrompt: Default to Direct; route any executable work through no more Goldilocks structure than the outcome earns.
Use continuity for long work, deliberate verification for high-risk work, and delegation only when ready units have net benefit.
Keep Lead on intent and integration; give Fast complete contracts and Standard only bounded domain judgment.
